user.title: Connect Albert Heijn
user.description:
Open this Albert Heijn login URL in your browser: {login_url}

Log in with Albert Heijn. When the browser redirects to appie://login-exit, copy the authorization code or the complete redirect URL and paste it below. Your AH password is never stored in Home Assistant.

data_description.authorization_code: Paste the value from the code parameter, or paste the complete appie://login-exit?... URL.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Albert Heijn
reauth_confirm.description: Albert Heijn authentication has expired. Open {login_url}, log in again, then paste the new authorization code or complete redirect URL.

error.invalid_auth: Albert Heijn did not accept this authorization code. Obtain a new code and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Albert Heijn API. Check your connection and try again.
error.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Albert Heijn account. Sign in with the account that was originally linked.

abort.already_configured: This Albert Heijn account is already configured.
